We have more information about membranous UFO seen on over the city of Porto, Portugal. There is allegedly a photograph of the craft, and it looks like a glowing aircraft. #UFO, #UFOs, #UAP, #UAPX

Most important points from the article   

Witnesses (several young people and others) described seeing a white object with erratic, spontaneous movements — quick direction changes that left observers astonished.   

Key details include:  

-It appeared to have propellers or rotating structures resembling "asas membranosas" (membranous wings), similar to those of bees or flies.  

-Some mentioned small lights or particles around it.  

-The sighting was brief due to cloudy conditions obscuring further view.
